resources.detail: Exchange of professional intelligence — I share my current status honestly, I receive the brief he has prepared. No money changes hands.

chosen_actions.description: Begin a quiet, targeted job search — not mass applications, but a short list of three to five community banks or regional credit unions within commutable range where my branch management experience and the commercial lending coursework would be a genuine fit. resources.detail: Research and networking effort only. No application fees. No recruiter costs at this stage.

response.inner_monologue: I did everything right and I still ended up unemployed. I flagged the risk early, I built the skills, I wrote the plan — and somehow that process ended with the employment status changing. I don't know if I was pushed out because I made too much noise, or if the bank restructured around the declining auto portfolio, or if something else happened that I still don't fully understand. What I know is: I have savings, I have skills, and I have a story to tell. Kevin prepared something for me. That matters. I am not going to panic-spiral — I am going to read that brief, keep studying, and start making careful calls.
